name: @home-compute/cloud
description: Home Compute's hosted control plane: the hc-web and hc-core Workers and their D1 schema.

scripts.migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply home-compute --local -c wrangler.web.jsonc --persist-to .wrangler/state
scripts.build: wrangler deploy --dry-run -c wrangler.web.jsonc --outdir dist/web && wrangler deploy --dry-run -c wrangler.core.jsonc --outdir dist/core
